title: Nightporch 1.1 is out: my AI-built survival life-sim went from one town to a twenty-town county
author: Shortykane
selftext:
Nightporch is a survival life-sim for the browser and iOS. You build a home, keep your survivors fed and sane, get to know the neighbours, and board up the windows before Horde Night.



It is built in Three.js. AI coding agents did most of the implementation, and local open-licence models did the art and audio.



Version 1.1 is live today in the browser and on the App Store. It is the first big update since launch.



\## What is new in 1.1



\- \*\*A world map.\*\* About twenty towns joined by roads. Walk or drive out, claim land, keep more than one home, and sell the ones you leave behind. Horde Night reaches every home you own.

\- \*\*Five kinds of country.\*\* Pine forest, lake country, red canyons, snowy mountains and burnt wasteland, each with its own ground, trees, animals and sounds.

\- \*\*Classes and a skill tree.\*\* Melee, Ranged or Mage, a class ability on the weapon bar, bows, and levels up to 50.

\- \*\*Bandits.\*\* Raider camps and walled villages hold the roads and go after your neighbours. Clear a camp and the land is yours.

\- \*\*Horde Night, rebuilt.\*\* A build-up through the afternoon, three named waves, special zombies, a boss on the big nights, and a Dawn Tally for every home.

\- \*\*Home building.\*\* Paintings, mirrors and wall hangings, plus pools you can dig, tile, fill and swim in.

\- \*\*Proper layouts.\*\* iPhone, iPad and Mac each get their own, instead of one layout stretched three ways.

\- \*\*Co-op.\*\* Your survivor in a friend's town stays yours while you are away.



\## What I learned building it with AI



\- \*\*Freeze something.\*\* The original mode is locked as "Classic" and its world generation has to stay byte-identical. That gave the agents a hard regression anchor.

\- \*\*Log every generated asset.\*\* Each image and sound has its model, seed and prompt recorded. Only commercially licensed local models are allowed: FLUX.2 Klein 4B and Z-Image Turbo for images, Stable Audio for sound. A build check fails anything else.

\- \*\*Look at the real screen.\*\* Layout assertions passed on screens that were plainly broken on an iPad. Captures at real device sizes, checked by a human, became a required gate.

\- \*\*Budget the agents.\*\* Token targets per task, one fix round, and each task tests only what it can break. The full suite runs once on the merged tree.

\- \*\*Generated art still needs a code pass.\*\* The store header render came back with two moons. A small script painted one out.



\## Play it



\- \*\*Browser, free:\*\* [https://spicyhuman.com/hearth-and-horde/](https://spicyhuman.com/hearth-and-horde/)

\- \*\*App Store, free:\*\* [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nightporch/id6812076093](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nightporch/id6812076093)



Happy to answer questions about the agent setup, the asset pipeline, or anything that looks off in the game.
